title: Make Your High School Schedule and We'll Guess How Many Kids You'll Have
content:
About This Quiz
High school is one of the few things in life that's considered binary. Usually, people either loved their high school days, or they absolutely hated them. But no matter how you currently feel, it's important to note that high school plays an essential role in everyone's lives. It teaches you how to wake up early for a future career, how to make friends, how to be respectful to others, and how to complete assignments by a certain due date. But if things were really up to you, how would you change your school schedule?
Would you remove exams altogether and simply get graded on homework assignments? Or would you add new and exciting after-school programs that teach students about leadership? You could also add in classes that teach students about the basics of life, such as how to do laundry, taxes and meal preparation. Your ideal high school schedule also says a lot about your personality and how organized you are. These organizational skills will then determine how many kids you'll have in the future, as well as how you'll be able to manage them. So whether that number will be none, one or 10, it's time to put school back in session with this scholarly quiz!Â
